operativeSourceText:
“Consolidated First Lien Secured Debt” means, as of any date of determination, the aggregate
principal amount of Indebtedness of the Borrower and its Subsidiaries outstanding on such date, determined on a consolidated basis in accordance with GAAP, consisting only of Indebtedness for borrowed money, Capitalized Lease Obligations and
purchase money Indebtedness, in each case secured by a first priority lien on the assets of the Borrower or any of its Subsidiaries; provided, Consolidated First Lien Secured Debt will not include Non-Recourse
Indebtedness, undrawn amounts under revolving credit facilities and Indebtedness in respect of any (1) letter of credit, bank guarantees and performance or similar bonds, except to the extent of obligations in respect of drawn standby letters
of credit which have not been reimbursed within three (3) Business Days and (2) Hedging Obligations.
“Consolidated
Interest Expense” means, with respect to any Pe

provenance.excerpt: "Consolidated Interest Expense" means, with respect to any Person for any period, without duplication, the sum of: (a) cash interest expense (including that attributable to Capitalized Lease Obligations), net of cash interest income, with respect to Indebtedness of such Person and its Subsidiaries for such period, other than Non-Recourse Indebtedness, including commissions, discounts and other fees and charges owed with respect to letters of credit and bankers' acceptance financing and net cash costs under hedging agreements (other than in connection with the early termination thereof); plus (b) non-cash interest expense resulting solely from (i) the amortization of original issue discount from the issuance of Indebtedness of such Person and its Subsidiaries at less than par (excluding any Indebtedness borrowed under the Facilities in connection with the Transactions and any Non-Recourse Indebtedness), plus (ii) pay-in-kind interest expense ... payable pursuant to the terms of the agreements governing Indebtedness for borrowed money; excluding, in each case: (i)-(xii) [twelve numbered carve-outs, e.g. amortization of deferred financing costs, hedging mark-to-market movements, hedging termination/breakage costs, Non-Recourse Indebtedness fees, registration-rights additional interest, make-whole premiums, tax penalties/interest, accretion of non-Indebtedness discounted liabilities, [reserved], recapitalization/purchase-accounting discounting, appraisal-rights interest, and administrative/collateral agency fees].

findings.proposedIrEvidence: calculationExpression = SUBTRACT( SUM[borrowed-money debt, CapLease, purchase-money debt (each secured by first lien)], SUM[Non-Recourse Indebtedness, undrawn RC amounts, SUBTRACT(LC/guarantee/bond debt - drawn unreimbursed standby LC), Hedging Obligations] )
findings.verifierReasoning: The proposed IR models the 'will not include' proviso as a literal arithmetic SUBTRACT of four independently-sourced METRIC_REFERENCE values (Non-Recourse Indebtedness, undrawn RC amounts, LC/guarantee/bond debt net of the standby-LC carve-back, and Hedging Obligations) from the SUM of the three enumerated secured-debt categories. This is a defensible translation if the base 'Indebtedness for borrowed money' metric (as broadly defined elsewhere in the agreement, per the unresolved 'Indebtedness' dependency) would otherwise sweep in these items absent the proviso - and the express carve-back for drawn-unreimbursed standby LCs suggests LC obligations can indeed be 'Indebtedness for borrowed money' under the base definition, lending some support to this approach. However, none of the metric references have a resolvedDefinitionId, and at least one exclusion category (undrawn RC amounts) is not economically part of 'outstanding' indebtedness in the first place, and Hedging Obligations/Non-Recourse debt secured status is not obviously coextensive with the SUM's 'secured by first lien' scope. If, in practice, the resolved metrics for these exclusion categories are not properly scoped/limited to amounts that would otherwise have been counted in the SUM, this SUBTRACT structure risks double-subtracting or improperly deflating the computed Consolidated First Lien Secured Debt figure relative to what the definition intends (a scope-narrowing clarification, not necessarily a netting calculation against unrelated totals). This is marked COMPLETE despite this unresolved interpretive/data-resolution risk, which a competent reviewer should be able to test.'

While the top-level calculationExpression is honestly marked kind:'UNSUPPORTED' with requiredReview:true (mitigating concern, similar to an honest MISSING_CONTEXT disclosure), the 'left' side components (cash interest expense, interest income, OID, PIK interest) are presented as definite METRIC_REFERENCE nodes without any UNSUPPORTED flag, and the sourceEvidence field for the exclusions purports to quote specific source language ('excluding, in each case: (i) amortization of deferred financing costs ... (xii) annual agency fees...') that cannot be verified against anything in the source text or context I was given. This is either drawn from source material not shared with me (in which case the sufficiency/provenance framing is misleading about what is verifiable here) or is fabricated detail masquerading as sourced content. Given the magnitude and specificity of the asserted content relative to the near-total absence of supporting source text, this warrants flagging even though the overall node is marked PARTIAL/UNSUPPORTED rather than COMPLETE.
